main_text.p: que magiæ Pontificiæ instrumenta, contra tertium Dei præceptum, indigna nominis Dei profanatione exorcizent, & tanquam salutis subsidia commendent. Quàm multos in ordinem sanctorum retulerint & adorent, qui aut * Baronius martyrolog. Roman. † Durandus Ration. diuin. officior.*nunquam, aut impij extiterunt: quam multa ijs† festa, templa, altaria consecrarint: quàm varios religionum modos, & diuersos Ecclesiæ ministrorum ordines, præter Dei verbum ‡ Ibid. lib.2. cap.1.+Ethnicorum exemplo instituerunt, & sædissimis, vt vocant, *Taxis & Annatibus diuendant. *Taxæ sacræ pænit.apostolicæ & Taxæ cancellar. apostolicæ. Quibus omnibus modis quartum Dei præceptum violatur. page.notes: Marginal notes on the left are transcribed inline at their positions. Several note markers (*, †, ‡, +) are small and partly blurred; some readings are uncertain. The word "osculaa" in the scan reads "ósculaa" and may be a printing error, the word "ad" before "conculcationem" is read as "*" in the scan. The final line "quàm" is a catchword-like fragment at the foot.
